definitions.gloss: to match, to agree, to coincide, to be consistent
definitions.explanation: For two or more things to be the same or in agreement. Used for opinions agreeing, data matching, fingerprints matching, descriptions coinciding, and people reaching consensus.

examples.japanese: ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一致|いっち}した。
⟦{指紋|しもん}→指紋：12728_shimon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦データベース→データベース：04720_deetabeesu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{一致|いっち}した。
⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一致|いっち}すること⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧めったにない。
examples.english: It is rare for everyone's opinions to agree completely.

notes:
An important word in both everyday and formal contexts. Used for consensus in meetings, matching data in investigations, and agreement of facts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一致|いっち}→一致：01733_icchi⟧: agreement of opinions
- ⟦{全会|ぜんかい}{一致|いっち}→全会一致：09760_zenkaiicchi⟧: unanimous agreement
- ⟦{満場|まんじょう}{一致|いっち}→満場一致：28977_manjouicchi⟧: unanimous (of an audience/assembly)
- ⟦{一致|いっち}{団結|だんけつ}→一致団結：20785_icchidanketsu⟧: united, acting in solidarity
- ～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{一致|いっち}する: to match with ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to match, to fit — everyday word for things matching or fitting together
- {一致|いっち}する: to agree, to coincide — more formal, used for exact correspondence
- ⟦{合致|がっち}する→合致する：20213_gacchisuru⟧: to conform to, to be in line with — very formal, used in legal and policy contexts
